summary: test(auth): cover SES bounce shapes and the EmailBounce model
description:
Because:
- Bounce handler tests missed most SES bounce, subType and complaint shapes.
- No test covered the EmailBounce model id mapping.

This commit:
- Adds SES notification shape tables to the auth-server bounces spec.
- Adds edge cases: unknown type, diagnosticCode limits, no headers, many recipients.
- Adds a Mocha spec for EmailBounce.create in fxa-shared.
- Pins the literal type ids, the unmapped fallback, and ER_DUP_ENTRY handling.

Closes FXA-12838
